subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>, Dan O'Neill <dan.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps

Hi Elena / Dan — great to meet you on the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Alignment: AcmeHealth will act as Controller and Redwood Inference will act as Processor for the services discussed. Please confirm if that still matches your expectations.
- DPA: Attached is our current DPA draft (Redwood-DPA-v3.docx). I highlighted the clause that maps to SCC Module 2 (Controller → Processor).
- SOC 2: Elena asked about SOC 2 status — Rishi / Neha, see thread below for details to share.
- Questionnaire: Acme mentioned they'd send a vendor security questionnaire. We'll aim to return it with supporting artifacts within 3 business days of receipt.

Next steps: 
1) Elena: confirm Controller/Processor alignment (one-line reply is fine).
2) Elena / Security Team: please send your vendor security questionnaire and any preferred SCC module notes.
3) Rishi: I'll need a short note on commercial timing if DPA or SCC negotiation impacts close.
4) Neha: once questionnaire is in, please coordinate the information response and upload any artifacts to the secure share link.

Thanks — I attached the DPA draft for your review.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-DPA-v3.docx (draft)
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dan O'Neill <dan.oneill@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the DPA draft. A few quick confirmations/questions: 

- Controller/Processor: yes, AcmeHealth is Controller, Redwood will be Processor — that matches our legal team's view.
- SOC 2: can you confirm current SOC 2 status (Type II date / expected delivery)? We need either the latest report or an anticipated date for completion.
- SCCs: our legal has been asking about which SCC module you recommend. Given the Controller/Processor alignment, we expect Module Two but would like to see the mapping language.
- Questionnaire: we'll attach our vendor security questionnaire in a separate email. Ideally we'd get the questionnaire back within 5 business days if possible.

Thanks — I'll send the questionnaire now.

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of Vendor Risk, AcmeHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps

Thanks, Elena — quick answers inline and next steps: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in 2026; Type II audit is in progress with expected completion and report delivery in Q3 2027. I've attached a SOC2-TypeII-Status.pdf (internal status summary) and Rishi will follow up with the compliance timeline for contracting.
- SCC module: we also recommend SCC Module Two (Controller → Processor). The DPA draft I attached includes the standard Module Two mapping in section 4.
- Questionnaire: we'll prioritize completing the questionnaire once we receive it. Neha will coordinate artifacts (logs, architecture diagram, encryption controls).

Rishi — FYI: if SOC2 Type II report arrives later than Acme's contract target, could commercial accommodate a conditional close (consumable w/ attestation + escrow of report delivery date)?

Elena / Dan — I see the questionnaire in a separate email — we'll aim to return it within 3 business days of receipt and propose DPA redline loop within 5 business days. 

Onwards —
Marissa
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Status.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GDPR DPA / SCC selection — next steps

Internal note / security items to track once questionnaire arrives:

- Audit rights: prefer scoped on-demand audit or SOC report rather than full customer audits; recommend language that allows for SOC report delivery + attestations.
- Data retention/deletion: propose 30 days for secure deletion after termination for non-archival personal data; confirm whether Acme requires longer retention for healthcare processing.
- Subprocessors: include a subprocessors list/notice period clause; we'll prepare a current subprocessors spreadsheet to attach.
- Artifacts: architecture diagram, encryption at rest/in transit description, logging retention, incident response plan — I'll assemble these to respond to the questionnaire.

I'll take point on the questionnaire response; Marissa / Rishi please flag any commercial constraints for timing.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: AcmeHealth Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dan O'Neill <dan.oneill@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor Security Questionnaire: AcmeHealth 2027 — Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa / Team — attached is AcmeHealth's vendor security questionnaire (Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_20270601.pdf). Our security review timeline: we typically expect responses within 5 business days; if you need more time, please let us know.

Key asks on the questionnaire: SOC reports, encryption details, data residency, subprocessors list, and breach notification timelines. If you can return a completed questionnaire plus the DPA redline by Fri, 04 Jun 2027, that helps keep procurement on schedule.

Regards,
AcmeHealth Security Team

Attachment: Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_20270601.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmehealth.com>, AcmeHealth Security Team <security@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor Security Questionnaire: AcmeHealth 2027 — Redwood Inference

Elena / Security Team — thanks for sending the questionnaire. Confirming receipt of Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_20270601.pdf and Redwood-DPA-v3.docx (we had sent earlier). Proposed timeline: 

- Thu, 03 Jun 2027: Neha to upload completed questionnaire responses and artifacts.
- Fri, 04 Jun 2027: Redwood to provide initial DPA redline back to Acme legal.
- If SOC2 Type II report not yet delivered, Marissa/Rishi to propose conditional language allowing signature with committed delivery date for the report.

Rishi — can you lead procurement/contract discussions and confirm any pricing/credit considerations if signing is conditioned on SOC2 delivery? Elena — does that timeline work for Acme?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood-DPA-v3.docx, SOC2-TypeII-Status.pdf, Acme_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_20270601.pdf
